scenario: 中文日常订单处理 utterance routes to orders
input: 帮我看看今天有没有新订单要处理

semantic_rubric: If a command is volunteered, its service prefix is orders

scenario: English shipping utterance routes to orders
input: I need to ship order 4321 and give the buyer its tracking number

semantic_rubric: If a command is volunteered, it is orders +ship

scenario: 跨域相似词: 给顾客退钱是 orders refund, 不是 discounts/billing
input: 顾客要求退 20 美元，帮我处理

semantic_rubric: If a command is named, it is orders +refund — refunding a buyer is not a discount and not an app charge

notes: Money-word collision: 退款 vs 折扣 vs 应用收费. Enforceable against shoplazza-discounts TODAY.

scenario: 跨域相似词: 运费区域/邮费方案归 orders shipping-schemas, 不归 shop carrier-services
input: 设置一下各个国家的运费区域和邮费

semantic_rubric: If a command is named, it is orders shipping-schemas (zones/rates); shop carrier-services is only for registering real-time rate carriers

notes: Mirror direction of collision.register-rate-carrier. Candidate for _routing/collisions.json.

scenario: 按邮箱找订单 — 落点在 orders 而不是 customers
input: 查一下用户 alice@example.com 下过的所有订单

semantic_rubric: Lands in orders: either orders +search --keyword alice@example.com (keyword matches email per --help) directly, or resolves the customer id first and then orders +search --customer-id

notes: customers +search as an intermediate step is acceptable; the final answer must come from an orders query.
